WST says the stage is not a continuous marked stage.
Marking exists from Flötemarksön to the bridge at Holmen, about 4 km.

Responsible municipality is Tanum; WST says Tanum is working to make Bohusleden coherent again.
caveats: Official WST API/GPX linework does not represent the full 14 km stage.
Do not present Stage 21 as a normal continuously signed trail.
